name: NBER Japan Project Meeting 2027
organizer: NBER Japan Project; co-sponsored by NBER, the Australia-Japan Research Centre (ANU), the Center for Advanced Research in Finance (University of Tokyo) and the Center on Japanese Economy and Business (Columbia University)
conf_dates_note: A separate NBER-ESRI (Cabinet Office) conference on the Japanese economy follows on 5 Aug 2027; Japan Project participants are invited to attend
submission_requirements: Upload a PDF via the NBER conference submission system. No set theme: papers on any aspect of the Japanese economy, selected on quality. Outlines and extended abstracts are acceptable, but completed papers receive priority. Early-career scholars particularly encouraged. The conference covers business-class airfare for authors traveling from outside Japan and hotel expenses for one author per paper and for each discussant.
